findings.note: Deletion success is now derived from observed removal/remaining-key results; enumeration failures are failures; user success/warning text follows the result. Reload has a persistent fallback warning if navigation does not occur.

RT-20 canary scan enumerates all values independently of APP_STORAGE_KEY_RE. NC-RT20-SCOPE produces expected FAIL then clean PASS. about:blank URL assertion was removed from PASS count and is explicitly NOT TESTED.

Claude-identified app hooks are build-flag/local-origin gated. PC-01 additionally found vendor GHRAB_AI.__testing public export as a sibling activation path; production build now strips that export and replaceForTesting is inert.
Manifest now declares rozbor_last_prompt_debug, Studio bridge keys, and the error-reporter fetch wrapper including fields it deliberately does not record.
audit-evidence/**/*.log is explicitly unignored after the global *.log rule.
Reporter exposes clearDraft(); endWork calls it before deletion, so draft/screenshots do not depend solely on successful reload.
Static CSP has one canonical source in security-headers.json and build injects it into index.template.html; exact parity is asserted against dist/index.html.

additionalFinding.description: Vendor GHRAB AI Core exposed __testing.setTestHooks/replaceRuntimeConfig in the production global API, providing a sibling route around an app-only test-hook fix.
additionalFinding.resolution: Production build strips the __testing API export while preserving the signed vendor source artifact unchanged; test builds retain it. App-level replaceForTesting is also build/local-origin gated.
